## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue (if applicable).

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code refactoring / performance optimization

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the repository conventions and formatting standards (`go fmt ./...`).
- [ ] Static analysis passes with no warnings (`go vet ./...`).
- [ ] All unit tests pass locally (`go test ./...`).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] The change preserves all AOF invariants (no runtime dependencies, offline-capable `aof init`, no silent file overwrite).
